user.title: Set up VerbrauchsMonitor
user.description: Central management for all contracts and electricity meters.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.description: Select, create or delete a contract. A wizard guides you through contract details when creating or editing.

meters.title: Meter selection
meters.description: Create a meter: continue directly to the form. For edit or delete, the meter selector appears directly below the action.

data_description.action: Edit or delete the selected meter. With no selection, a new meter is created.

billing.title: Bills and advances
billing.description: Manage billing records and monthly advances.

about.title: About VerbrauchsMonitor
about.description:
Version 0.0.2 – Dev  
Revision: {revision}  
Developer: Muschelschubser26 & ChatGPT  
Support: [Support@gehtdoch.eu](mailto:Support@gehtdoch.eu)

meter_edit.title: Configure meter
meter_edit.description: Configure meter data, its contract and measurement entities. The final reading of the previous billing period is the calculation basis. Feed-in and other measurements are optional. Selected entities are used automatically; empty optional fields are not stored.

data.name: Meter name
data.previous_consumption_reading: Consumption meter reading at billing start (kWh, decimal comma supported)
data.previous_feed_in_reading: Feed-in meter reading at billing start (kWh, decimal comma supported)

contract_wizard_identity.title: Contract – Step 1 of 2
contract_wizard_identity.description: Enter the provider, contract name and contract number. Set the billing period start and duration.

contract_wizard_prices.title: Contract – Step 2 of 2
contract_wizard_prices.description: Set the billing areas and their prices. Finish saves the contract.

booking_edit.title: Create or edit payment
booking_edit.description: Assign the logical meter and billing direction first. Unresolved legacy bookings are excluded until assigned.

meter_select.title: Select meter
meter_select.description: Select the meter to edit or delete. The first meter is selected by default.

additional_values.title: Additional values
additional_values.description: Configure optional hub-wide measurements. Outdoor illuminance is independent of individual meters.

database_status.title: Database status
database_status.description: Show database status. The result is displayed here after execution.

database_optimize.title: Optimize database
database_optimize.description: The database will be checked and rewritten compactly.

database_import.title: Import database
database_import.description: Enter a filename from www/verbrauchsmonitor. Existing data is backed up first.

data_management.title: Data management
data_management.description: Select the scopes to reset. A separate confirmation follows. Resetting contracts also requires resetting meters.

data_management_confirm.title: Confirm reset
data_management_confirm.description: Selected scopes: {scopes}. The database file is backed up before reset. Explicitly confirm the action.

data.confirm: I confirm resetting the selected scopes

contract_select.title: Select contract
contract_select.description: Select the contract for the previously selected action. The action is retained.

contract_delete_confirm.title: Confirm contract deletion
contract_delete_confirm.description: Do you really want to delete the selected contract?

database_reset_confirm.title: Confirm database reset
database_reset_confirm.description: A backup of the database file will be created before resetting. This removes the current database.

forecast.title: Configure forecasts
forecast.description: Enable forecasts independently for each meter reading. Consumption is enabled by default and feed-in is disabled. The feed-in advance is configured in the associated contract. The current astronomical season is calculated automatically from the Home Assistant location: {current_season}. No Season integration or manual selection is required.

advance_meter.title: Select electricity meter
advance_meter.description: Select the electricity meter whose monthly advances you want to edit.

advance_months.title: Edit monthly advances
advance_months.description: Months are shown from the billing period start through the current month. Future months are not shown.

billing_bookings.title: Manage bookings
billing_bookings.description: Select, edit or delete existing bookings, or create a new booking.

forecast_reset_select.title: Reset forecasts
forecast_reset_select.description: Select the meter readings and directions whose forecasts should be reset. All configured meter readings are listed.

error.contract_in_use: Der Vertrag ist noch einem Zähler zugeordnet. Ändere zuerst die Zählerzuordnung.
error.invalid_contract: The selected contract does not exist.
error.required_identity: Provider, contract name and contract number are required.
error.no_meters: No meter exists yet. Create a new meter first.
error.invalid_reading: Enter a valid meter reading. Use a comma for decimal places.
error.invalid_amount: Enter a valid amount. Decimal comma is supported.
error.reset_contracts_require_meters: Contracts can only be reset together with meters.
error.contract_flow_internal_error: Internal error while moving to the next contract step. The existing contract was not changed; see Home Assistant logs for details.
error.invalid_tariff: Enter a valid price with no more than six decimal places.
error.invalid_assignment: Meter, contract and billing direction must match.
error.duplicate_billing_type: Consumption and feed-in cannot be selected twice.
error.invalid_billing_period: Enter a valid start date and a duration of at least one month.
error.invalid_advance_amount: Enter a valid non-negative amount for each month.
error.save_failed: The booking could not be saved. Please check the system log and database status.

abort.missing_billing_start: No billing period start is configured for the selected meter.
abort.no_current_billing_month: The current month is outside the billing period.
